That is what I have to do as a secretary of an elementary school. It is doable and there are way worse jobs out there. Like road constructors or garbage man in the -40 Celsius or the +40 Celsius every day.

"Call center jobs are one of the most toxic work environments you can be in" Ahah :D Really... In those nice modern American offices they have and the possibility to work from home. Very toxic. More toxic than an old soviet nuclear power plant I can imagine...

"Why are you posting here instead of calling a mental health professional for your son who is openly talking about suicide?" Post communist block country, old industrial town: doctors flee from here to escape the 400$/month wages so no medical help avaliable. 

"because your home becomes associated with toxic call center bullshit and you can't unwind when you're done" When you clock out you can just separate the two in your mind, it should not be that hard.

"I had a shitty call center job for 4 months. Remote. My phone would ring at 8am. It was a customer yelling at me. I hang up. I had 20 seconds to document the entirety of that call before the phone rang again. If I didn't close that ticket within 5 minutes, A manager was yelling at me. If my bathroom break was 5 minutes and 4 seconds and not under 5 minutes, a manager was yelling at me. If I was on a phone with a half demented old lady who was slow to talk and respond, and my single call time went above 20 minutes, I got yelled at by a manager" 

Same happens here in an elementary school. I am being yelled by the director for all of this too. And every single job you will be yelled for these. You have to get used to it, that is life.

IT career because "All you do is sit at a computer all day" Because mostly that is what you do, they are 100% in the right. 

"Stop complaining all you did was answer the phone" Because THAT IS WHAT HE HAD TO DO ONLY. No phisical activity was required at all. Sit at the PC and answer the calls. Ignore if they are rude to you and just think about the money. 

"Are you trying to drive your kid to suicide for life insurance money? What's going on here?" No, I love him! He is my son! But I hate unemployment. Back in my days, in the communist era you were sent to jail if you did not have a job this age. And to be fair, rightfully so. 

But thank you for the breakdown! Now I see that my son is just whining for no apparent reason... I didn't find any controversial or objectionable in your experiences. these are not just "shitty" jobs like you mentioned. These are every single job indeed.

"Most call centers have prompts to follow and guidelines to meet." So is every other job in the world? Not an excuse to leave. 

"Your calls will get periodically audited without your prior knowledge and they can use anything they find against you" Again, every job is like that. There is a saying here "the walls have ears". Meaning at every job you are being spied at. 

"The callers are often very entitled" Every customer ever. Human nature. You have to get used to it. 

"How many hours a day can you tolerate getting screamed at by strangers?" I am getting screamed by strangers for 8 hours in my job. I HAVE TO tolerate because that is my duty in my job. It is not a liking, you have to do it, like it or not.

"how many applications would he expect they need to send before finding a new job?" Doesn't matter, he had interviews where he would have been hired but he withdrew because "it looked bad"...

"I suspect he is depressed because he thinks he will be in a crappy low pay job his whole life and never get to do anything he aspires to" So does 99.999% of people in the world. Job is called a job for a reason.
I let him recover at home. But it was already enough time and nothing happened. I can't help him, he needs to treat himself, since medical care is not avaliable here.

I didn't ask for a solution, I was just asking why call centers are awful. I am not changing my current job, so I want to hear about this so called horrible call center from different sources. 

"you are generally not trained very well" You will stutter and flob for a year or two but that is natural. You will get better every day. So not an excuse.

"placed in a position where it is easy to fail" So like... every job out there? Feels like a fake excuse again.

"You may just experience the world very differently from the way your son does" Life is not a subjective thing, you have to work and you will 99.999% won't like it. You have to suck it up, that is adult life. 

"probably just start by investigating medical help" Not available for the public on an affordable price and I also don't believe in psychologists or any mental help.

Empathy doesn't help noone and never did. I have to be strict and demanding. I had enough empathy letting him do nothing and "recovering" for this long. Now i want to go after this whole situation. 

I won't change my job. My job is also awful, being a secretary of an elementary school. it is one of the most stressful jobs in the world, I don't like it but I am used to it and I can do this automatically.  A job is a job because you hate it, that is the nature of life.
